proof_body:
by
  intro R L _ _ _ h
  set Rad := LieAlgebra.radical R L with hRad
  apply LieAlgebra.hasTrivialRadical_of_no_solvable_ideals
  intro J hJ
  let π : L →ₗ⁅R⁆ L ⧸ Rad := { (LieSubmodule.Quotient.mk' Rad : L →ₗ[R] L ⧸ Rad) with map_lie' := fun {x y} => LieSubmodule.Quotient.mk_bracket Rad x y }
  have hπ : Function.Surjective π := LieSubmodule.Quotient.surjective_mk' Rad
  have hmap : ∀ (I : LieIdeal R L) (k : ℕ), LieIdeal.map π (LieAlgebra.derivedSeriesOfIdeal R L k I) ≤ LieAlgebra.derivedSeriesOfIdeal R (L ⧸ Rad) k (LieIdeal.map π I) := by
    intro I k
    induction k with
    | zero => exact le_rfl
    | succ k ih =>
      rw [LieAlgebra.derivedSeriesOfIdeal_succ, LieAlgebra.derivedSeriesOfIdeal_succ]
      exact LieIdeal.map_bracket_le π |>.trans (LieSubmodule.mono_lie ih ih)
  obtain ⟨k, hk⟩ := LieAlgebra.IsSolvable.solvable R J
  rw [LieIdeal.derivedSeries_eq_bot_iff] at hk
  have hC : LieIdeal.map π (LieIdeal.comap π J) = J := by
    apply le_antisymm LieIdeal.map_comap_le
    intro y hy
    obtain ⟨x, rfl⟩ := hπ y
    exact LieIdeal.mem_map (by simpa using hy)
  have h1 : LieAlgebra.derivedSeriesOfIdeal R L k (LieIdeal.comap π J) ≤ Rad := by
    have h2 := hmap (LieIdeal.comap π J) k
    rw [hC, hk, le_bot_iff, LieIdeal.map_eq_bot_iff] at h2
    intro x hx
    have h3 := h2 hx
    rw [LieHom.mem_ker] at h3
    exact (LieSubmodule.Quotient.mk_eq_zero (N := Rad)).mp h3
  have hsolv : LieAlgebra.IsSolvable (LieIdeal.comap π J) := by
    obtain ⟨l, hl⟩ := LieAlgebra.IsSolvable.solvable R Rad
    rw [LieIdeal.derivedSeries_eq_bot_iff] at hl
    refine LieAlgebra.IsSolvable.mk (R := R) (k := l + k) ?_
    rw [LieIdeal.derivedSeries_eq_bot_iff, LieAlgebra.derivedSeriesOfIdeal_add]
    exact eq_bot_iff.mpr (hl ▸ LieAlgebra.derivedSeriesOfIdeal_mono h1 l)
  have h4 : LieIdeal.comap π J ≤ Rad := (LieAlgebra.LieIdeal.solvable_iff_le_radical R L _).mp hsolv
  rw [← hC, eq_bot_iff, LieIdeal.map_le_iff_le_comap]
  intro x hx
  have := h4 hx
  rw [LieIdeal.mem_comap]
  exact (LieSubmodule.Quotient.mk_eq_zero (N := Rad)).mpr this
target_source: ∀ (R : Type*) (L : Type*) [CommRing R] [LieRing L] [LieAlgebra R L], IsNoetherian R L → LieAlgebra.HasTrivialRadical R (L ⧸ LieAlgebra.radical R L)
